import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors1 = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars1 = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values, color=colors1)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Filter out invalid ages and get numeric age values
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna() & (df['AlterVHundNum'] >= 0) & (df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 20)]
sns.histplot(data=age_data, x='AlterVHundNum', bins=20, ax=ax2, color='steelblue', edgecolor='white')
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontweight='bold')

# Plot 3: Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors3 = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(district_counts))
bars3 = ax3.barh(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values, color=colors3)
ax3.set_yticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax3.set_yticklabels(district_counts.index)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontweight='bold')

# Plot 4: Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create cross-tabulation of owner gender and dog gender
gender_cross = pd.crosstab(df['SexLang'], df['SexHundLang'])
gender_cross.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#95E1D3'], edgecolor='white')
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Gender')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Gender', fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', loc='upper right')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
